title: Praeparatio evangelica / «Евангельское приготовление»
author: Eusebius of Caesarea
genre: Apologetics (anthology of pagan and Jewish sources)
edition: Mras, GCS 43 (1954–56; rev. 1982–83); Gifford, Oxford 1903 (Greek text + English), public domain
ru_evidence: pravenc.ru 'Евсевий' lists only Book XI (Yastrebov, ЦиВр 2002, plus fragments); azbyka.ru lists only Book XI. Demonstratio evangelica: no Russian translation listed.
other_translations: French: Sources Chrétiennes, several books (not verified here)
value: A treasure-house of lost Greek prose: Philo of Byblos, Porphyry's Philosophy from Oracles, Oenomaus of Gadara, Diogenianus, Atticus, Numenius, Aristocles. Central for historians of Greek religion, oracles and philosophy.
ai_feasibility: high for the prose; medium for embedded hexameter oracles and attributing fragments.
pilot_unit: Book V.18–VI.7: Oenomaus' 'Detection of Frauds' on oracles, with Eusebius' frame; est. 12–15k words
